name: What should I prepare before having a deck drainage system installed?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before having a deck drainage system installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation, you should clear the area beneath your deck of any furniture, plants, or obstructions to allow easy access for the installation team. It's also beneficial to inspect your deck's substructure for any signs of damage or rot yourself; while our team will conduct a thorough assessment, addressing obvious issues beforehand can prevent delays. If you plan to finish the under-deck area with lighting or ceiling fans, consider discussing these plans with your installer early, as wiring may need to be integrated with the drainage system's structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installation, clear the under-deck area and inspect the substructure. Discuss any plans for finishing the under-deck space, like lighting, with your installer.
